methods.enumeration: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard under campaign prefix; exact byte snapshot
methods.full_reference_match: Case-insensitive literal matches for original and normalized full transcript strings >=28 characters; no phrase values included in receipt
methods.json_structure: Populated raw text/transcript/vector/embedding/credential key fields and numeric arrays longer than64
methods.image_review: All three Git-eligible PNGs visually reviewed: idle empty caption state, and two explicitly synthetic Alex/Blair fixture states; no private corpus transcript visible
methods.evidence_review: Final main and supplemental summary/CSV cardinalities, counters, paired taps, source frame delivery, lexical inclusion/omission and denominators independently reconciled

excluded_payloads: full reference and recognized speech text
model binaries and native build binaries
complete journals and GUI images of actual corpus speech
ignored dependency junction, bytecode and interim reports
publication_scope: Existing repository remains public. Only reviewed source, manifests, small redacted reports and three synthetic/idle images enter Git or the analysis handoff.
later_metadata_receipts: This privacy receipt and the final Git/package status receipts contain only paths, hashes, sizes, counts and reviewed completion statements. Final receipt changes are checked separately before packaging.
scan_limit: Pattern and structural checks supplement source/report and image review; the full-reference phrase check covers strings of at least28characters and is not the sole privacy check.
